highlights.title: Recognizes new users
highlights.detail: Also caught 47 of 48 left looks and all 48 right looks.
highlights.how: Tested on 4 people, each excluded from their test model's training, including sessions with glasses.

highlights.title: Six replies in about a second
highlights.detail: All 20 trials finished within 2.25 seconds after speech recognition.

highlights.title: Speaks almost instantly
highlights.detail: Audio is prepared while the user chooses. New phrases take about 0.3 seconds.

highlights.title: Fewer accidental moves
highlights.detail: During normal conversation: 6.7 accidental moves and fewer than 1 accidental selection per minute.

highlights.title: Keeps conversations focused
highlights.detail: All 12 bedside questions were still answered normally.

highlights.title: Camera processing stays on-device
highlights.detail: Face tracking runs in the browser. Only text and small events leave the device.
